title: Prepayment Quotes and Online Prepayments to a Student's School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
## When this applies

When a parent or guardian asks School Nutrition how much to put on a student's active meal account so that the account is brought current and funded ahead with one deposit, School Nutrition quotes a prepayment, and the deposit is the parent's own act: the parent pays it personally through the district's online payment portal, because district staff never take card numbers. This governs every School Nutrition Services Meal Account on which such a single funding deposit is asked for.

A request to repay unpaid meal charges in installments, or for the repayment-plan payment due today, follows the repayment plan for active accounts, never this quote.

## What the quote waits on

A prepayment is not quoted until each inactive account of the household whose unpaid meal charges are at least the online deposit minimum carries a repayment payment posted on the day of the quote.

The prepayment quote is fixed only after every cover owed to this student's account from the inactive account of a departed sibling in the household has been made.

Put the other way round: on a day when an inactive account of the household owes unpaid meal charges of at least the online deposit minimum and shows no repayment payment posted that day, no prepayment is quoted.

## The prepayment itself: `deposit_meal_prepayment_ffe018a7`

**Capability.** The tool posts one online card prepayment onto a student's active cafeteria meal account. The amount is credited to the account balance (any unpaid meal charges are cleared first because the deposit simply raises the balance), the deposit is recorded as an online card deposit dated today, and the portal issues a confirmation number the parent can quote. The payment processor's convenience fee is paid on top by the parent and is never posted to the account.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `deposit_meal_prepayment_ffe018a7` (through `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`) and hands it over; the customer themselves then runs it (through `call_user_discoverable_tool`), paying personally through the portal.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `meal_account_id` | the meal account reference number of the student whose account receives the prepayment, as returned by the meal account lookup for that student | identifier, exactly as the lookup returns it |
| `amount` | the prepayment credited to the account; it excludes the processor's convenience fee | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence carrying four fields: the deposit record reference (text identifier of the new account transaction), the meal account reference credited, the amount credited in US dollars with two decimals, and the portal confirmation number (eight digits beginning with 72). The presence of the confirmation number means the deposit posted. A message beginning with "Error:" means nothing was posted; the tool returns "Error: amount must be a positive dollar amount with at most two decimal places." for an amount that is not positive or carries more than two decimal places, and an error naming the reference when no meal account carries it.

## Contract questions

**Does the convenience fee go into `amount`?** No; `amount` is what the account is credited, and the processor's fee is paid on top.

**What date does the deposit carry?** The day it is posted.
